name: Mobility
tagline: Move safely around home and town.
description: Wheelchairs, rollators and knee scooters, fitted to your height and weight and adjusted before we leave.

name: Respiratory
tagline: Oxygen, sleep therapy and breathing treatments.
description: Home and portable oxygen, CPAP systems and nebulizers, set up by a respiratory therapist who shows you every step.

name: Hospital beds
tagline: Care at home, with the right bed and surface.
description: Semi-electric beds and pressure-relief mattresses, delivered, assembled and placed where you need them.

name: Bathroom safety
description: Shower chairs, transfer benches and raised toilet seats that make the bathroom safer for everyone.

name: Lifts and seating
tagline: Safer transfers for patients and caregivers.
description: Patient lifts and lift chairs, with in-home training for family members and caregivers.

name: Diabetes supplies
description: Glucose meters and test strips, billed to your plan and shipped automatically before you run out.
